text.p: The following are leading domestic stories in Portuguese newspapers.
- The evaluation of Portugal Telecom necessary for the third phase of the privatisation of the company is ready. The company is worth about 1,300 billion escudos.

- Negotiations for the participation of Saudi Aramco in the capital of Petrogal are at risk due to crisis in relations between private shareholders of Petrogal and state Secretary for Industry and Energy Jose Penedos.

- Civil servants will receive lower retirement pensions if the proposals of the commission for the reform of the social security system are followed by the government, sources linked to the process said.

- State transfers to support small and medium companies and for the administration of roads has had an impact on the budget deficit, totalling 204.5 billion escudos (4.6 percent of GDP) in the first five months of the year.
